_comment: Minimal fixture for the STM32G0 boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit (the inline RCC stub in the local stm32g0b1.repl satisfies the HSI/PLL ready bits), TIM2 advances the firmware clock (generic/timer_irq.c + stm32f0_timer.c on this Cortex-M0+), and klippy completes its identify + clocksync + config handshake over the USART1 pty Renode exposes. Free-run (no tick_mode): the no-motion path has no timer pressure, so klippy's clocksync adapts to the Renode CPU's effective rate without a shutdown (the log notes 'configured for 64Mhz but running at NNMhz', which is the expected free-run wall-clock-vs-virtual adaptation, not an error). The local stm32g0b1.repl supplies the G0B1's 512KB flash + 144KB SRAM and omits the IWDG watchdog (whose macro-less reset in Renode is fatal). Uses the stm32g0b1 build.
